_notes.siteName: Optional label shown above the title (e.g. your name or org). Leave "" to hide.
_notes.dollarsPerMillionTokens: Blended $/million-tokens rate for all dollar estimates. Pick a rate that reflects the model you mostly run (e.g. ~15-30 for premium tiers). It's an assumption — the page says so.
_notes.recallTokensPerObservation: Conservative model of what it costs to recall one memory. saved = work_tokens - (observations * this).
_notes.graphifyAssumedQueriesPerDay: ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY. Graphify keeps no per-query log, so the monthly-saved projection assumes this many graph queries/day. Labelled as an estimate on the page.
_notes.claudeMemDbPath: Path to the claude-mem SQLite DB. Default is where claude-mem installs it. Supports ~ and absolute/relative paths.
_notes.graphify.graphPath: Path to your graphify-out/graph.json. Relative paths are resolved from where you RUN the collector (your repo root), then from this folder.
_notes.graphify.searchPaths: Extra locations to auto-search if graphPath isn't found — handy when one dashboard tracks a graph in a sibling repo.
_notes.scope.mode: 'global' = every project in the claude-mem DB. 'projects' = only scope.projects[].
_notes.scope.projects: Project names to include when scope.mode is 'projects'.
_notes.highlightProjects: Project names to visually highlight (a 'pinned' tag) in the per-project breakdown. Optional.
